title: Zesty Fermented Venezuelan Beans Casserole
description: A comforting Venezuelan dish featuring fermented beans, raspberry jam, and a mirepoix base, served in a bento box. This vegetarian friendly casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion, carrot, and celery until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the mashed fermented beans, raspberry jam, cooked quinoa, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir until well combined.
Add the sauteed mirepoix to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a bento box and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
